task: Tier 2: PERF-1 state.json copy-on-write cache; COR-F-1 chapter draft-overwrite guard; COR-F-3 event timestamp default + detectNewerRun narrowing

app/db/state_helpers.py.summary: PERF-1: added a copy-on-write in-memory cache for state.json keyed on (path, mtime_ns, size). _load_state_no_lock() now returns the shared cached dict on a signature match (READ-ONLY contract) instead of re-reading+parsing every call. New _load_state_for_update_no_lock() returns a deepcopy for mutators (preserves the pre-cache guarantee that a mid-mutation exception leaves committed state untouched). New _commit_state_no_lock() is the single write chokepoint (persist + adopt as cache + refresh signature). New _prime_cache_no_lock/_state_file_signature/_invalidate_state_cache helpers. save_state()/load_state() route through the chokepoint / return copies. External writes (e.g. migration) and STATE_FILE path switches change the signature and force a reload.

app/db/state_jobs.py.summary: PERF-1: the 6 mutators (put_job, update_job, prune_completed_jobs, delete_jobs, clear_all_jobs, purge_jobs_for_chapter) now load via _load_state_for_update_no_lock() and persist via _commit_state_no_lock() (prune_completed_jobs also fixed to use the chokepoint instead of writing STATE_FILE directly). get_jobs() stays on the fast read-only _load_state_no_lock() path.

app/db/state_settings.py.summary: PERF-1: update_settings() routes through _load_state_for_update_no_lock()/_commit_state_no_lock(); get_settings()/set_engine_cap() stay readers. Also fixed a latent aliasing bug: _normalize_settings now copies the nested enabled_plugins dict before mutating it (line ~47), so a reader (get_settings) can no longer corrupt the shared state cache via the required-setting-disable path.

frontend/src/hooks/chapter/useChapterLoa.summary: COR-F-1: loadChapter no longer overwrites an unsaved local title/source-text edit. Added currentTitleRef/currentTextRef (live draft mirror) + lastLoadedTitleRef/lastLoadedTextRef (last server value this hook applied); setTitle/setText are skipped when the draft differs from the last-loaded server value (unsaved edit), while a genuine server change with no local edit still applies. Guard covers mount, WS-tick, and completion-poll reloads.

frontend/src/utils/jobEventAdapters.ts.summary: COR-F-3: resolveEventUpdatedAt now returns undefined (was Date.now()/1000) when a frame carries no timestamp, so a provenance-less frame can no longer masquerade as the newest and defeat the stale-frame / status-regression guards.

frontend/src/utils/jobUpdateReducer.ts.summary: COR-F-3 (companion): narrowed detectNewerRun's no-incoming-timestamp branch so a non-terminal job's benign rollback-status fluctuation (e.g. SEGMENT_PENDING running->preparing) is still treated as the current run continuing, while a TERMINAL (done/failed/cancelled) job now requires a genuine numeric timestamp advance to be un-terminated. Prevents COR-F-3's fix from over-blocking a legitimate same-run case.

flow_impact: PERF-1 changes state.json access from read-through-per-call to a cache with a single write chokepoint; behavior (observable job/settings state) is unchanged, only the read cost. No flow topology change.
